title: INLEAP Photonics raises €20M to expand laser counter-drone systems
title_bn: ইনলিপ ফোটনিক্স লেজার এন্টি-ড্রোন সিস্টেম সম্প্রসারণের জন্য ২০ মিলিয়ন ইউরো সংগ্রহ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: German deeptechcompany INLEAP Photonics has raised approximately €20 million in seed fundingto scale its laser-based counter-drone technology for defence and criticalinfrastructure applications. The r...
paragraph1: German deeptech company INLEAP Photonics has raised approximately €20 million in seed funding to scale its laser-based counter-drone technology for defence and critical infrastructure applications. The round was led by UVC Partners, with participation from HTGF in Germany, Poland's Balnord, Estonia's Sentris and Denmark's Scale Capital. INLEAP Photonics develops high-precision, ultra-fast laser beam steering systems for neutralising unmanned aerial vehicles.
paragraph2: Its technology is being developed for both military applications and the protection of civilian and critical infrastructure, including airports, energy facilities and data centres. The company is developing its systems as demand for counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS) increases amid the growing use of drones and concerns over the risks they pose to defence and civilian sites. INLEAP Photonics is working with customers and partners including the German Federal Ministry of Defence and the Bundeswehr Cyber Innovation Hub.
paragraph3: The company has also entered into a strategic partnership with German defence technology company STARK Defence. According to Marius Lammers, founder and CEO of INLEAP Photonics, the company is seeing increased demand for its technology and will use the financing to expand its manufacturing and delivery capacity. Our technology has reached the market and we are seeing strong order intake.
paragraph4: We are now investing in manufacturing, quality assurance, sales and service to meet demand and deliver our systems at greater scale, said Lammers. The funding will be used to expand production and testing capacity, further develop the company's core laser technology and grow its sales, customer support and service operations in Germany and other European markets. INLEAP Photonics also plans to invest in quality assurance and certification processes for deployment in industrial and security-critical environments, while continuing to expand its team.
bangla_paragraph1: জার্মান ডিপটেক কোম্পানি ইনলেপ ফোটনিক্স প্রতিরক্ষা এবং সমালোচনামূলক অবকাঠামো অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলির জন্য তার লেজার-ভিত্তিক কাউন্টার-ড্রোন প্রযুক্তিকে স্কেল করার জন্য প্রায় ২০ মিলিয়ন ইউরো seed তহবিল সংগ্রহ করেছে। রাউন্ডটি ইউভিসি পার্টনার্স দ্বারা পরিচালিত হয়েছিল, জার্মানির এইচটিজিএফ, পোল্যান্ডের বালনর্ড, এস্তোনিয়ার সেন্ট্রিস এবং ডেনমার্কের স্কেল ক্যাপিটালের অংশগ্রহণে। ইনলেপের ফোটোনিক্স ড্রোনযুক্ত বিমানকে নিরপেক্ষ করার জন্য উচ্চ-নির্ভুলতা, অতি-দ্রুত লেজার বিম স্টিয়ারিং সিস্টেমগুলি বিকাশ করে।
bangla_paragraph2: এর প্রযুক্তি সামরিক অ্যাপ্লিকেশন এবং বিমানবন্দর, শক্তি সুবিধা এবং ডেটা সেন্টার সহ বেসামরিক এবং সমালোচনামূলক অবকাঠামোর সুরক্ষার জন্য উভয়ই বিকাশ করা হচ্ছে। সংস্থাটি ড্রোনগুলির ক্রমবর্ধমান ব্যবহার এবং প্রতিরক্ষা এবং বেসামৰিক সাইটগুলিতে তাদের ঝুঁকি নিয়ে উদ্বেগ বাড়ানোর মধ্যে কাউন্টার-ড্রোন বিমান সিস্টেমের (সি-ইউএএস) চাহিদা বাড়ার সাথে সাথে তার সিস্টেমগুলি বিকাশ করছে। ইনলেপ ফোটনিক্স জার্মান ফেডারেল প্রতিরক্ষামন্ত্রী এবং বুটেন সহ গ্রাহক এবং অংশীদারদের সাথে কাজ করছে।
bangla_paragraph3: কোম্পানিটি জার্মান প্রতিরক্ষা প্রযুক্তি কোম্পানি স্টার্ক ডিফেন্সের সাথেও কৌশলগত অংশীদারিত্ব করেছে। ইনলিপ ফোটনিক্সের প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ও প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা মারিয়াস ল্যামার্স অনুসারে, কোম্পানি তার প্রযুক্তির চাহিদা বৃদ্ধি পাচ্ছে এবং তার উত্পাদন ও বিতরণ ক্ষমতা প্রসারিত করতে অর্থায়ন ব্যবহার করবে। আমাদের প্রযুক্তি বাজারে পৌঁছেছে এবং আমরা শক্তিশালী অর্ডার ইনকাম দেখছি।
bangla_paragraph4: "আমরা এখন চাহিদা মেটাতে এবং আমাদের সিস্টেমগুলিকে বৃহত্তর স্কেলে সরবরাহ করতে উত্পাদন, গুণমান নিশ্চিতকরণ, বিক্রয় এবং পরিষেবাতে বিনিয়োগ করছি", ল্যামার্স বলেছিলেন। তহবিলটি উৎপাদন ও পরীক্ষার ক্ষমতা প্রসারিত করতে, কোম্পানির মূল লেজার প্রযুক্তি আরও বিকাশ করতে এবং জার্মানি এবং অন্যান্য ইউরোপীয় বাজারে তার বিক্রয়, গ্রাহক সহায়তা এবং পরিষেবা কার্যক্রম বাড়াতে ব্যবহৃত হবে। ইনলেপ ফোটোনিক্স শিল্প এবং সুরক্ষা-সমালোচনামূলক ক্ষেত্রে স্থাপনের জন্য গুণমানের নিশ্চয়তা এবং শংসাপত্রের প্রক্রিয়াগুলিতেও বিনিয়োগ করার পরিকল্পনা করেছে।

title: Chinese court freezes $318 million in Nexperia assets as Wingtech presses to regain control — Dutch chipmaker says seizures won't affect day-to-day operations
title_bn: উইংটেক নিয়ন্ত্রণ ফিরে পেতে চাপ দিচ্ছে বলে চীনের আদালত নেক্সপেরিয়ার সম্পদের ৩১৮ মিলিয়ন ডলার জমে রেখেছে  ডাচ চিপ নির্মাতা বলেছেন যে জব্দগুলি প্রতিদিনের কার্যক্রমকে প্রভাবিত করবে না
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The total value of the frozen assets exceeds Wingtech’s entire first-half revenue, with the company reporting 1.51 billion yuan in H1 2026 sales, down more than 90% year over year.
paragraph1: (Image credit: Getty / Bloomberg) A court in Dongguan, China, has frozen 2.14 billion yuan (roughly $318 million) in assets held by Dutch chipmaker Nexperia and its equipment arm, ITEC, according to a filing that Chinese parent company Wingtech Technology submitted to the Shanghai Stock Exchange today. The order covers Nexperia's equity in five Chinese subsidiaries and runs until August 2029, handing Wingtech fresh leverage in its year-long fight to regain control of Nexperia that Dutch authorities stripped from it in 2025.The Dongguan Intermediate People's Court civil ruling, which Wingtech said it received on August 28, freezes Nexperia B.V.'
paragraph2: s 100% stakes in Nexperia Semiconductor (China), Nexperia Semiconductor (Wuxi), and Nexperia Semiconductor (Shanghai), plus its 99% holding in Nexperia Semiconductor Technology (Shanghai). A fifth order covers ITEC B.V.'s full stake in its equipment subsidiary, ITEC Technology (Wuxi). The underlying case, an 8 billion yuan (roughly $1.
paragraph3: 19 billion) damages claim that Wingtech filed in May against Nexperia, its holding company, ITEC, and three executives, hasn't gone to trial.Those five entities are the same Chinese operations that stopped following instructions from Nexperia's Nijmegen headquarters in October last year, when Nexperia accused them of refusing payment for delivered wafers and opening unauthorized bank accounts. Nexperia says it has no control over those businesses today, and the court order now bars any sale, transfer, or restructuring of their equity for three years. Any settlement of the wider ownership dispute that involves carving up Nexperia's China assets can't close before August 2029 unless the Dongguan court first suspends the asset freeze.In that May complaint, Wingtech named chief legal officer Ruben Lichtenberg, chief operating officer Achim Kempe, and Stefan Tilger, the CFO who has led Nexperia as interim chief executive since a Dutch court suspended founder Zhang Xuezheng last October.
paragraph4: It alleges that the trio implemented or helped enforce discriminatory restrictive measures imposed by the Netherlands, whose government briefly seized control of Nexperia before suspending its intervention last November.The total value of the frozen assets exceeds Wingtech’s entire first-half revenue, with the company reporting 1.51 billion yuan in H1 2026 sales, down more than 90% year-over-year, alongside a 406 million yuan net loss. Its shares trade under Shanghai's *ST delisting-risk designation after auditor RSM couldn't verify 57% of its assets, most of which are inside Nexperia entities that Wingtech can't access. Nexperia China, meanwhile, has been qualifying domestic wafer suppliers and producing chips on 12-inch wafers.
paragraph5: In a statement to Bloomberg, Nexperia said that the measures relate "solely to entities in China that have been operating outside Nexperia BV's governance structures" and don't affect its day-to-day operations, management, or business continuity. title: Cambridge University spinout launches AI model "competitive" with OpenAI and Anthropic
title_bn: কেমব্রিজ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের স্পিনআউট ওপেনএআই এবং অ্যানথ্রপিকের সাথে এআই মডেল "প্রতিযোগিতামূলক" চালু করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: A Cambridge University spinout has today launched a “frontier-class” generalist AI model which it says is competitive with OpenAI and Anthropic's leading models and can be deployed locally. Flower Lab...
paragraph1: A Cambridge University spinout has today launched a “frontier-class” generalist AI model which it says is competitive with OpenAI and Anthropic's leading models and can be deployed locally. Flower Labs is a London and Hamburg-based startup which lets companies train AI models using data that stays where it is, rather than being transferred to one central server. For example, a hospital could maintain patient data within its systems. The startup, founded in 2023, has raised over £23m, and its founders are Y Combinator alumni.
paragraph2: Flower Labs bills itself as a full-stack AI startup, building open-source models, agents and infrastructure. It has today announced the launch of Endeavor 1.0, an AI model built on open-source models as well as leveraging the reasoning power of its proprietary model and in-house software. The startup is pitching the model as a credible sovereign alternative to US closed-source models accessed via an API or less capable open-source models.
paragraph3: Flower Labs says it offers “frontier performance while giving organisations a credible route to make that intelligence a durable part of their own technology”. It comes amid a push by the UK government to support domestic alternatives to Silicon Valley AI giants and a push from European governments to deploy AI locally and have greater data and security control. Endeavor can be deployed on a business’s IT systems, offering businesses increased control and security, the startup says, using Flower Lab's tech “for most workloads while deploying select applications privately”. Professor Nicholas Lane, co-founder, chief scientist at Flower Labs and a professor of machine learning at Cambridge University, told the Times: “Europe should not have to rent its intelligence indefinitely from a handful of US companies.
paragraph4: ” Flower Labs says Endeavor matches OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol and Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 on some tasks while outperforming Moonshot’s Kimi K3 on some benchmarks. Flower Labs, whose clients include the NHS and JP Morgan, is launching the model to a select group of organisations, ahead of a broader rollout as it looks to ramp up its compute. On the ambitions of Endeavor, it says: “Our goal with Endeavor is not simply to provide another model endpoint.
paragraph5: We want organisations to be able to start with frontier capability and build a lasting AI foundation around it, extending the model with their own agents, evaluations, data pipelines, and improvement loops over time.” Endeavor will be available under licence, with clients able to train the model on data which does not have to be transferred to a centralised server.
bangla_paragraph1: কেমব্রিজ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের একটি স্পিনআউট আজ একটি ফ্রন্টারি-ক্লাস জেনেরালিস্ট এআই মডেল চালু করেছে যা এটি বলে যে ওপেনএআই এবং অ্যানথ্রপিকের শীর্ষস্থানীয় মডেলগুলির সাথে প্রতিযোগিতামূলক এবং স্থানীয়ভাবে স্থাপন করা যেতে পারে। ফ্লাওয়ার ল্যাবস একটি লন্ডন এবং হামবুর্গ ভিত্তিক স্টার্টআপ যা সংস্থাগুলিকে একটি কেন্দ্রীয় সার্ভারে স্থানান্তরিত হওয়ার পরিবর্তে ডেটা ব্যবহার করে এআই মোডেলগুলি প্রশিক্ষণ দেয়। উদাহরণস্বরূপ, একটি হাসপাতাল তার সিস্টেমের মধ্যে রোগীর ডেটা বজায় রাখতে পারে। 2023 সালে প্রতিষ্ঠিত স্টার্ট আপটি 23 মিলিয়ন পাউন্ডেরও বেশি উত্থাপন করেছে এবং এর গবেষণা
bangla_paragraph2: ফ্লাওয়ার ল্যাবস নিজেকে একটি ফুল-স্ট্যাক এআই স্টার্টআপ হিসাবে ঘোষণা করে, ওপেন সোর্স মডেল, এজেন্ট এবং অবকাঠামো তৈরি করে। এটি আজ এন্ডিভর ১.০ চালু করার ঘোষণা দিয়েছে, এটি ওপেন-সোর্স মোডালগুলির উপর নির্মিত একটি এআই মডেল এবং এর মালিকানাধীন মডেলের যুক্তির শক্তি এবং অভ্যন্তরীণ সফ্টওয়্যারটি ব্যবহার করে। স্টার্ট আপটি এপিআই বা কম সক্ষম ওপেনসোর্সের মডেলগুলির মাধ্যমে অ্যাক্সেসযোগ্য মার্কিন বন্ধ-সোস মডেলে বিশ্বাসযোগ্য সার্বভৌম বিকল্প হিসাবে মডেলটি পিচ করছে।
bangla_paragraph3: ফ্লাওয়ার ল্যাবস বলছে যে এটি সীমান্ত কর্মক্ষমতা প্রদান করে, যখন সংস্থাগুলিকে তাদের নিজস্ব প্রযুক্তির একটি টেকসই অংশে সেই বুদ্ধিমত্তা তৈরি করার জন্য একটি বিশ্বাসযোগ্য রুট দেয়। এটি সিলিকন ভ্যালির এআই জায়ান্টদের অভ্যন্তরীণ বিকল্পগুলিকে সমর্থন করার জন্য যুক্তরাজ্য সরকারের চাপের মধ্যে এবং স্থানীয়ভাবে এআই স্থাপন এবং বৃহত্তর ডেটা এবং সুরক্ষা নিয়ন্ত্রণের জন্য ইউরোপীয় সরকারগুলির চাপের মাঝে আসে। এন্ডিওভার একটি ব্যবসায়ের আইটি সিস্টেমে স্থাপন করা যেতে পারে, ব্যবসায়কে বর্ধিত নিয়ন্ত্রণ এবং সুরক্ষার প্রস্তাব দেয়, স্টার্টআপটি বলেছে, ফ্লাওয়্যার ব্যবহার করে
bangla_paragraph4: ফ্লাওয়ার ল্যাবস বলছে যে এন্ডিভর ওপেনএআই এর জিপিটি-৫.৬ সোল এবং অ্যানথ্রোপিক এর ক্লাউড ফ্যাবল ৫ এর সাথে কিছু কাজে মিলছে, কিছু বেঞ্চমার্কে মুনশট এর কিমি কে৩ এর চেয়েও ভাল পারফরম্যান্স করছে। ফুল ল্যାବস, যার ক্লায়েন্টদের মধ্যে এনএইচএস এবং জেপি মরগান রয়েছে, এটি একটি বিস্তৃত রোলআউট করার আগে একটি নির্বাচিত গোষ্ঠীর কাছে মডেলটি চালু করছে কারণ এটি তার কম্পিউটিংকে বাড়িয়ে তুলতে চায়। এন্ডীভরের উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষা সম্পর্কে এটি বলেছেঃ এন্ডিভার সহ আমাদের লক্ষ্য কেবলমাত্র অন্য মডেলের শেষ পয়েন্ট সরবরাহ করা নয়।
bangla_paragraph5: আমরা চাই যে সংস্থাগুলি সীমান্ত সক্ষমতা দিয়ে শুরু করতে এবং এটির চারপাশে একটি স্থায়ী এআই ভিত্তি তৈরি করতে সক্ষম হোক, সময়ের সাথে সাথে তাদের নিজস্ব এজেন্ট, মূল্যায়ন, ডেটা পাইপলাইন এবং উন্নতির লুপগুলির সাথে মডেলটি প্রসারিত করে।

title: Save $300 on this 240Hz OLED gaming laptop with an RTX 5070 Ti, now just $1,899 — Acer Predator Helios rig ships with a 24-core Intel CPU, 32GB DDR5 and a 1TB SSD

author: TechPulse
excerpt: This Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI gaming laptop has dropped to just $1,899.99, giving you a high-end rig with an RTX 5070 Ti, 32GB DDR5 and a 1TB SSD.
paragraph1: A great deal on an OLED gaming laptop could be yours, if you're quick. This Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI machine has dropped to just $1,899.99 right now, giving you a machine capable of X, thanks to the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 Ti included within. Powerful GPU aside, this 16-inch laptop also ships with 32GB of DDR5 RAM and a 1TB SSD, with this deal saving you $300 on its usual price thanks to Best Buy's Labor Day sale. ● Check out this deal at Best Buy The Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI features an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor, an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 Ti laptop GPU with 12GB of fast GDDR7 VRAM, 32GB of RAM, and a 1TB PCIe Gen 4 SSD. This is a high-end spec sheet built with gaming in mind.
paragraph2: The 16-inch display is one of the big MVP's here, though, with an insanely fast 240Hz refresh rate on a gorgeous-looking OLED panel that'll make games look stunningly vibrant.You simply won't find a better alternative for gaming on a laptop than an OLED panel like this one, either. OLED's are fast, with near-instantaneous response times and infinite contrast ratios that give a depth and clarity to the colors on your screen that a traditional LCD can't really match. For gaming, the mobile version of the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is still powerful, even if it doesn't quite match the desktop version. It still has 12GB of VRAM, however, which will mean you can easily hit high frame rates at the OLED display's native 2,560 x 1,600 resolution, along with a pared-down count of 5,888 CUDA cores. You'll be able to manage high and ultra graphics presets in the most intensive games, with Nvidia DLSS support helping in a crunch, thanks to multi-frame generation.
paragraph3: 32GB of DDR5 RAM and a 1TB SSD means you're not compromising on storage or memory with this Acer gaming laptop, despite the AI price boom affecting the entire market this year. Both are more than enough to handle the demands of modern gaming, along with any productivity work you might need to complete. You're also getting the Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX CPU, which has 24 cores, eight of which are the best-for-gaming performance cores.You're getting a mix of plastic and metal with this laptop's chassis, all-black with RGB lighting, with customizable zones all over. You've got longevity with this build, too, with two DDR5 RAM slots that support up to 64GB, along with two M.2 slots.
paragraph4: It's thin and lightweight, weighing just 5lbs with a thickness of just 19mm. You get a good amount of ports, too, including USB-C, and USB-A, along with Ethernet and HDMI. Wireless connectivity is included with Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.4, with a 76Wh battery that Acer claims will last almost all day long.The $1,899.99 sale price for this 16-inch Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI gaming laptop is a seriously good one in the current market.
paragraph5: Less than $2,000 for an OLED gaming laptop, especially with these specs, is a deal that you'll struggle to match elsewhere. This Best Buy Labor Day sale discount is set to run out by September 7, but with a deal this good, expect it to sell out before then. title: VinFast Halts Cars Production In India To Reassess Costs: Report
title_bn: ভিনফাস্ট ভারতে গাড়ি উৎপাদন বন্ধ করে দিয়েছে, খরচ পুনর্বিবেচনা করেছে: রিপোর্ট
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Vietnamese EV maker VinFast is reportedly halting its production of select cars in India to reassess costs. Reuters reported that…
paragraph1: SUMMARYVietnamese EV maker VinFast is reportedly halting its production of select cars in India to reassess costs Local manufacturing was expected to help the company reduce costs and eventually price its cars more competitively in India The company has asked its suppliers to hold all activities on three programmes, including a two-door SUV called VF3, VF6 and VF7 SUVs Vietnamese EV maker VinFast is reportedly halting its production of select cars in India to reassess costs. Reuters reported that the company has asked its suppliers to hold all activities on three programmes, including a two-door SUV called VF3, VF6 and VF7 SUVs. As per sources, VinFast could not achieve its planned costs for developing and sourcing parts locally in India. Local manufacturing was expected to help the company reduce costs and eventually price its cars more competitively in India.
paragraph2: The report further said that VinFast has asked suppliers to share details of investments already made for the three vehicle programmes, raising questions about the potential financial impact on component makers and whether suppliers will be compensated for tooling, engineering and other investments undertaken for the projects. Inc42 has reached out to VinFast Asia CEO Tapan Ghosh for comments on the development. The story will be updated based on the response. Last year, the Vietnamese EV major planned to boost its annual electric vehicle production up to 1.
paragraph3: 5 Lakh in India and export them to countries in the Middle East and Africa, depending on its market demand. Following which, VinFast inaugurated its first manufacturing facility in India at Thoothukudi in Tamil Nadu, with committed phased investments of up to ₹16,000 Cr ($2 Bn) and an additional $500 Mn in December. The facility has given the Vietnamese company a significant lead in manufacturing. It is targeting to produce 50,000 vehicles from the plant annually and scale this capacity to 1.
paragraph4: 5 Lakh units once fully operational. Besides this, VinFast parent Vingroup-owned electric mobility arm Green SM entered the Indian market with the launch of Green SM Limo, an electric cab service, in Delhi NCR in June. It is pertinent to note that the current development does not necessarily mean VinFast is stopping sales of its vehicles in India. The automaker will continue assembling the VF6 and VF7 models at its Tamil Nadu facility using completely knocked-down (CKD) kits imported from Vietnam.
paragraph5: VinFast entered the Indian passenger EV market with the launch of the VF6 and VF7 electric SUVs earlier this year.

title: Hot Chips 2026: Samsung reveals a three-phase HBM roadmap that puts logic and compute inside memory — zHBM ultimately stacks DRAM directly on top of the processor
title_bn: হট চিপস ২০২৬: স্যামসাং একটি তিন-ফেজ এইচবিএম রোডম্যাপ প্রকাশ করেছে যা মেমরির ভিতরে লজিক এবং কম্পিউটিং রাখে  জেএইচবিএমের শেষ পর্যন্ত ড্রাম সরাসরি প্রসেসরের উপরে স্ট্যাক করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Samsung detailed a three-phase HBM roadmap at Hot Chips 2026 that progressively moves logic into the base die and ultimately stacks DRAM directly on the processor.
paragraph1: Samsung has unveiled a three-phase roadmap to progressively transform high-bandwidth memory (HBM) into an integrated memory-and-compute system, culminating in the company's zHBM architecture, which places the processor directly beneath the DRAM stack and eliminates the conventional 2.5D interposer link between the two.
paragraph2: Detailing the roadmap at Hot Chips 2026, Samsung's Sangwook Han, of the company's DRAM design team, identified the base die as the key enabler of the evolution, which began with the company’s decision to manufacture the HBM base die on an advanced logic process.In conventional HBM, the base die (B-die) was fabricated on the same DRAM process node as the core dies (C-dies) in the stack above.
paragraph3: Starting with HBM4, Samsung moved the base die to a 4nm logic process, primarily to reduce power draw and minimize die area. Additionally, it gave Samsung a much more capable piece of silicon.

title: ID Finance secures €21M from nordIX to grow its Spanish lending business
title_bn: আইডি ফিনান্স তার স্প্যানিশ ঋণ ব্যবসায়ের প্রসার করতে নর্ডআইএক্স থেকে ২১ মিলিয়ন ইউরো সুরক্ষিত করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Fintech company ID Financehas secured a €21 million debt facility from German asset manager nordIX tosupport the continued growth of its consumer lending business in Spain.Founded in Barcelona in2015,...
paragraph1: Fintech company ID Finance has secured a €21 million debt facility from German asset manager nordIX to support the continued growth of its consumer lending business in Spain. Founded in Barcelona in 2015, ID Finance operates in Spain and Mexico, providing digital financial services focused on consumer lending. The company has more than 3.
paragraph2: 7 million registered users in Spain, where it offers small, short-term consumer loans through a digital platform. ID Finance will use the new facility to finance additional consumer loans originated through its platform and expand its credit portfolio in Spain. The financing will increase the capital available for new loan originations and add to the company's institutional funding sources.
paragraph3: During the first half of the year, ID Finance originated more than €190 million in consumer loans in Spain and reported approximately €100 million in revenue. According to Boris Batine, co-founder and CEO of ID Finance, the agreement represents a further step in expanding the company's alternative lending platform in Spain. By increasing our lending capacity, it will enable us to finance more originations and continue expanding the portfolio.
paragraph4: nordIX’s support also reflects investor confidence in the platform’s operating model, its established track record in Spain and the disciplined approach to risk management that has underpinned its growth. The debt facility forms part of ID Finance's broader funding strategy to diversify its sources of institutional capital and support the longer-term development of its consumer lending business in Spain.
bangla_paragraph1: ফিনটেক সংস্থা আইডি ফিনান্স স্পেনের ভোক্তা ঋণ ব্যবসায়ের অব্যাহত বৃদ্ধিকে সমর্থন করার জন্য জার্মান সম্পদ ব্যবস্থাপক নর্ডআইএক্স থেকে ২১ মিলিয়ন ইউরো debtণ সুবিধা সুরক্ষিত করেছে। ২০১৫ সালে বার্সেলোনায় প্রতিষ্ঠিত, আইডি Finance স্পেন এবং মেক্সিকোতে কাজ করে, ভোক্তার ঋণে মনোনিবেশ করে ডিজিটাল আর্থিক পরিষেবা সরবরাহ করে। সংস্থার ৩.৫ মিলিয়ন ডলার এরও বেশি ঋণ রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: আইডি ফিনান্স নতুন সুবিধাটি ব্যবহার করে তার প্ল্যাটফর্মের মাধ্যমে প্রাপ্ত অতিরিক্ত ভোক্তা ঋণগুলি অর্থায়ন করবে এবং স্পেনে তার ক্রেডিট পোর্টফোলিও সম্প্রসারণ করবে। এই অর্থায়নে নতুন ঋণের প্রারম্ভের জন্য উপলব্ধ মূলধন বৃদ্ধি পাবে এবং কোম্পানির প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক অর্থায়নের উত্সগুলিতে যোগ করা হবে।
bangla_paragraph3: বছরের প্রথমার্ধে, আইডি ফিনান্স স্পেনে ১৯০ মিলিয়ন ইউরোরও বেশি ভোক্তা loansণ উত্পন্ন করেছে এবং প্রায় ১০০ মিলিয়ন ইউরো আয় করেছে। আইডিফিনান্সের সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা এবং প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা বরিস বাটিনের মতে, এই চুক্তিটি স্পেনের কোম্পানির বিকল্প ndingণ প্ল্যাটফর্ম প্রসারিত করার ক্ষেত্রে আরও একটি পদক্ষেপ। আমাদের ndingণদানের ক্ষমতা বাড়িয়ে, এটি আমাদের আরও উত্পাদন এবং পোর্টফোলিও প্রসারণ অব্যাহত রাখতে সক্ষম করবে।
bangla_paragraph4: নর্ডআইএক্স এর সমর্থন প্ল্যাটফর্মের অপারেটিং মডেলের প্রতি বিনিয়োগকারীদের আস্থা, স্পেনে তার প্রতিষ্ঠিত রেকর্ড এবং ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনার শৃঙ্খলাবদ্ধ পদ্ধতির প্রতিফলন করে যা তার বৃদ্ধির ভিত্তিতে রয়েছে। ঋণ সুবিধাটি আইডি ফিনান্সের প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক মূলধনের উৎসগুলিকে বৈচিত্র্যময় করার জন্য বৃহত্তর তহবিল কৌশল এবং স্পেনের ভোক্তা ঋণ ব্যবসায়ের দীর্ঘমেয়াদী বিকাশকে সমর্থন করার অংশ।

title: NPCI To Launch Agentic Payments On UPI: Report
title_bn: ইউপিআই-তে এজেন্টিক পেমেন্ট চালু করবে এনপিসিআই: রিপোর্ট
author: TechPulse
excerpt: UPI operator NPCI is reportedly looking to launch a framework which would see AI agents execute small-ticket digital payments without…
paragraph1: SUMMARYNPCI plans to launch the ‘Unified Agent Protocol’ next week at the Global Fintech Fest in Mumbai The protocol would allow AI agents to execute UPI payments without the user having to manually approve each transaction, utilising the existing UPI Circle and Reserve Pay features NPCI itself demonstrated a pilot of agentic payments on UPI last year, while fintech startups like Pine Labs, Razorpay, and Cashfree have already been building tools to enable agentic payments UPI operator NPCI is reportedly looking to launch a framework which would see AI agents execute small-ticket digital payments without requiring explicit user authorisation for every transaction. The NPCI is likely to unveil the ‘Unified Agent Protocol’ next week at the 2026 edition of the Global Fintech Fest in Mumbai, as per a report by Reuters. The protocol aims to leverage existing UPI mechanisms, including UPI Circle and Reserve Pay, to allow users to delegate payment authority to AI agents within a pre-set limit. For context, the UPI Circle feature enables a primary user to authorise family members and other trusted individuals to make payments on their behalf, while Reserve Pay allows users to block funds at one time for multiple future payments. NPCI declined to comment when Inc42 reached out for their inputs.
paragraph2: The initial rollout of the agentic AI framework will target low-value, high-frequency transactions such as grocery orders and routine digital purchases. Over time, NPCI expects AI agents to handle more sophisticated use cases like placing orders automatically based on sales or discounts, as per sources close to the publication. The payments body plans to provide merchants with infrastructure to directly integrate with the protocol. It will also enable customers to set rules for AI agents on when and how much to pay. The NPCI began piloting an agentic AI framework for UPI last year, marking the next phase of what it calls “intelligent commerce”.
paragraph3: The payments body had showcased a live demo of the offering at the Global Fintech Fest 2025. Besides the agentic AI framework, the NPCI is also likely to announce a few other updates for UPI at the GFF 2026. It is also reported to be announcing interoperability for UPI AutoPay, allowing users to port their existing mandates across UPI apps and merchants to move mandates from one payment provider to another. However, AI integration within UPI has been in the works for some time now. In the last edition of GFF, NPCI partnered with Razorpay and OpenAI to launch agentic payments on ChatGPT and explore AI-driven commerce at a national scale.
paragraph4: Powered by Razorpay’s banking partners, Axis Bank and Airtel Payments Bank, and built on UPI innovations such as UPI Circle and UPI Reserve Pay, the initiative allows UPI transactions for AI-native shopping. As agentic AI becomes more advanced, payments are naturally coming to the forefront as a prime use case. Global credit card networks Visa and MasterCard are already experimenting with frameworks to allow consumers’ AI agents to execute transactions on their behalf. Fintech startups have also been working on enabling agentic payments in the domestic private sector. Pine Labs rolled out its own agentic payments protocol, P3P, earlier this year.
paragraph5: Razorpay has been experimenting with agentic commerce by helping merchants build storefronts that can be integrated into AI platforms like ChatGPT, while Cashfree is focusing on products that enable merchants to enable in-chat transactions on the same.

title: AIRMO takes aim at methane leaks from space
title_bn: মহাকাশ থেকে মিথেনের ফুটো লক্ষ্য করে এয়ারমো
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The International Energy Agency (IEA) estimates that about 200 billion cubic metres (bcm) of natural gas is lost annually through leaks, venting and flaring — enough to cover roughly two‑thirds of the...
paragraph1: The International Energy Agency (IEA) estimates that about 200 billion cubic metres (bcm) of natural gas is lost annually through leaks, venting and flaring — enough to cover roughly two‑thirds of the EU’s annual gas consumption. Founded in 2022, AIRMO is a space-tech company building a methane-emissions monitoring platform for the energy industry. It combines measurements from drones, aircraft, and satellites to detect methane leaks, quantify emissions, identify sources, and turn that information into actionable data companies can use to address leaks and meet regulatory requirements. Daria Stepanova, CEO and co-founder of AIRMO, is a space engineer with expertise in satellite development, launch operations, and commercialisation. She leads AIRMO’s commercial strategy, fundraising, and international expansion. Her first exposure to space came through a student team while at university. She told me, “I found the idea that, within a year, you could go from nothing with a student team to actually building working satellite systems that could go into space so cool.” The experience inspired her to pursue a career as a space engineer. She went on to co-found several startups and previously served as CTO of German Orbital Systems. Today, AIRMO has a team of 34 drawn from space tech, oil and gas, and other sectors. “Our CTO has been involved in launching around 50 satellites, and we have people with decades of experience building space optics. But many people on the team have only recently entered the space industry. They bring their expertise from elsewhere.” Detecting methane from space AIRMO is developing two instruments for atmospheric monitoring, including microlidar tech.
paragraph2: Stepanova explained: “We've built an instrument that's pretty compact but still very powerful. It measures atmospheric conditions and provides information about aerosols and dust particles." The second instrument to be sent to space is a short-wave infrared spectrometer. There's less novelty, but it's still state-of-the-art in terms of size, compactness, and signal performance. Combining these two sensors gives the company unique data around methane emissions. It can detect and precisely quantify emissions better than existing commercial systems, "and deliver that at a much lower cost because we use a small-satellite approach." "We deploy small satellites, so this combination of accuracy, reliability, and cost-effectiveness is what we see the market wanting. Our customers want to see as much data as possible and have continuous monitoring of their assets, but not with crazy overheads.” The largest methane emissions tend to occur upstream, where oil and gas are extracted and processed. Some of these high-volume leaks are already large enough to detect from space. Further along the supply chain, however, smaller leaks can occur around pipelines and storage infrastructure and may require more granular monitoring. “You need to address all of them to have an impact,” said Stepanova. “Of course, the impact of finding the larger leaks is much greater.” The problem with monitoring methane on the ground Currently, much methane monitoring is still carried out manually, with workers walking along pipelines using handheld devices and outdated cameras.
paragraph3: “Imagine a huge facility covering several square kilometres. You have to physically walk around it,” explained Stepanova. “That’s what makes it so expensive. Then there’s offshore infrastructure, where monitoring is obviously even more complicated. I think that’s one of the reasons why the industry isn’t willing to do it more frequently. It’s expensive, painful, and takes a long time. It’s not digitised.” Testing from drones and aircraft before space Before launching its satellite, AIRMO is deploying its instruments on drones and aircraft, mounting the sensors underneath specially equipped planes that fly over facilities to detect and measure emissions.  Stepanova explained that adding sensors to commercial aircraft comes with extensive certification requirements. Instead, AIRMO works with companies that provide aircraft specifically equipped for remote-sensing and monitoring missions. According to Stepanova, deploying AIRMO’s technology in the field before its satellite launches also provides valuable insights into how customers use the data. “We see a lot of value in actually going into the field, understanding the environmental conditions, and seeing how our customers receive the data, how they use it, and how they implement these technologies. It gives us a lot of knowledge that we can use to improve our product.“ Ultimately, the product is the same: methane monitoring.
paragraph4: It’s a map showing methane leakages that’s updated regularly. Whether that data comes from satellites or aeroplanes, the product remains the same. With drones and planes, the company is already validating its technology and conducting monitoring campaigns. According to Stepanova, deploying AIRMO’s technology in the field also provides valuable insights into how customers use the data. AIRMO has started with customers that are most suitable for satellite monitoring. For the company, upstream oil and gas is the most interesting market, with a concentration in regions such as the Middle East, Central Asia, and North Africa. But conducting airborne monitoring campaigns in these regions can be logistically challenging. “You need to figure out the process of getting your instruments into the country. It took us six months to bring a drone into Saudi Arabia, where we've been doing campaigns. It's a long, painful, experimental, and sometimes annoying process,” explained Stepanova. These logistical challenges are another reason AIRMO sees satellites as central to scaling its monitoring platform. Satellites can provide global, continuous monitoring without requiring equipment to be transported into each country, although they cannot offer the same precision as drones. The cost of leaking methane Customers broadly fall into two camps: those motivated by the financial cost of methane leaks and those driven by regulatory compliance and decarbonisation commitments. “Some inspections are done only once a year,” said Stepanova.
paragraph5: “When you deliver the report, and they see how much methane they've lost over the year because they haven't identified those emissions, the motivation changes. It becomes: "Oh my God, that's so much money." With airborne observations, data is transmitted within the day, with the broader goal of mitigating leaks within a week, though this depends on the facility's location and applicable regulations. There are regulations that require leaks to be mitigated within a certain timeframe, and customers typically respond very quickly. Satellites should also make it easier for AIRMO to verify whether identified leaks have been repaired and provide ongoing monitoring. Doing the same with airborne campaigns can quickly become expensive, as each follow-up requires another flight over the facility. Preparing for launch AIRMO is working with partners with a long track record of successful space missions, which provide the satellite platform that will carry its instrument. According to Stepanova, there's still work to do to match the interfaces and ensure the payload can withstand the temperature swings and vibrations during launch. "We also need to ensure it can survive and operate for long enough in space. That’s the work we’re doing at the moment: manufacturing, testing that everything works and can withstand those conditions, and working closely with our partners in preparation for launch.” AIRMO is aiming to launch its first satellite offering with EnduroSat by the end of 2027.
bangla_paragraph1: আন্তর্জাতিক শক্তি সংস্থা (আইইএ) অনুমান করে যে প্রতি বছর প্রায় 200 বিলিয়ন ঘনমিটার (বিসিএম) প্রাকৃতিক গ্যাস ফুটো, ভেন্টিলেশন এবং জ্বলন্ত  এর মাধ্যমে হারিয়ে যায় যা ইইউ এর বার্ষিক গ্যাস খরচ প্রায় দুই-তৃতীয়াংশের জন্য যথেষ্ট। 2022 সালে প্রতিষ্ঠিত, এয়ারমো একটি মহাকাশ প্রযুক্তি সংস্থা যা শক্তি শিল্পের জন্য একটি মিথেন নির্গমন পর্যবেক্ষণ প্ল্যাটফর্ম তৈরি করে। এটি ড্রোন, বিমান এবং উপগ্রহ থেকে পরিমাপকে একত্রিত করে মিথেনের ফুটো সনাক্ত করতে, নির্গমণ পরিমাণ নির্ধারণ করতে, উত্সগুলি সনাক্ত করার জন্য এবং তথ্যটি পরিণত করতে।
bangla_paragraph2: স্টেপানোভা ব্যাখ্যা করেছিলেনঃ "আমরা একটি যন্ত্র তৈরি করেছি যা বেশ কমপ্যাক্ট কিন্তু এখনও খুব শক্তিশালী। এটি বায়ুমণ্ডলীয় অবস্থার পরিমাপ করে এবং এয়ারোসোল এবং ধুলোর কণা সম্পর্কে তথ্য সরবরাহ করে।" মহাকাশে পাঠানো দ্বিতীয় যন্ত্রটি একটি স্বল্প তরঙ্গ ইনফ্রারেড স্পেকট্রোমিটার। এটি কম নতুনত্ব, তবে এটি আকার, কমপ্যাসিটি এবং সংকেত কর্মক্ষমতার দিক থেকে এখনও state-of-the-art। এই দুটি সেন্সরকে একত্রিত করা কোম্পানিকে মিথেন নির্গমন সম্পর্কে অনন্য তথ্য দেয়। এটি সনাক্ত করতে এবং সঠিকভাবে পরিমাণযুক্ত করতে পারে
bangla_paragraph3: কয়েক বর্গ কিলোমিটার বিস্তৃত একটি বিশাল সুবিধা কল্পনা করুন। আপনাকে এটির চারপাশে শারীরিকভাবে হাঁটতে হবে,  স্টেপানোভা ব্যাখ্যা করেছিলেন। এটিই এটিকে এত ব্যয়বহুল করে তোলে। তারপর অফশোর অবকাঠামো রয়েছে, যেখানে পর্যবেক্ষণ অবশ্যই আরও জটিল। আমি মনে করি এটি শিল্পটি আরও ঘন ঘন করতে ইচ্ছুক নয় এমন একটি কারণ। এটি ব্যয়বহল, বেদনাদায়ক এবং দীর্ঘ সময় নেয়। এটি ডিজিটালাইজড নয়। মহাকাশের আগে ড্রোন এবং বিমান থেকে পরীক্ষা করা তার উপগ্রহ চালু করার আগে, এআইআরএমও মোতায়েন করা হয়।
bangla_paragraph4: এটি একটি মেথেন ফুটো দেখানো মানচিত্র যা নিয়মিত আপডেট করা হয়। এই ডেটা উপগ্রহ বা বিমান থেকে আসে কিনা, পণ্যটি একই থাকে। ড্রোন এবং বিমানের সাথে, সংস্থাটি ইতিমধ্যে তার প্রযুক্তি যাচাই করছে এবং পর্যবেক্ষণ প্রচারণা পরিচালনা করছে। স্টেপানোভার মতে, ক্ষেত্রের মধ্যে এয়ারমোর প্রযুক্তি স্থাপন করা গ্রাহকরা কীভাবে ডেটা ব্যবহার করে সে সম্পর্কে মূল্যবান অন্তর্দৃষ্টিও সরবরাহ করে। এয়ারএমও গ্রাহকদের সাথে শুরু করেছে যা উপগ্রহ পর্যবেক্ষনের জন্য সবচেয়ে উপযুক্ত। সংস্থার জন্য, আপস্ট্রিম তেল
bangla_paragraph5: আপনি যখন রিপোর্টটি প্রদান করেন, এবং তারা দেখেন যে তারা বছরের মধ্যে কত মিথেন হারিয়েছে কারণ তারা এই নির্গমনগুলি সনাক্ত করেনি, অনুপ্রেরণা পরিবর্তন হয়। এটি হয়ে যায়ঃ "ওহ মাই গড, এটি এত টাকা।" বায়ুভিত্তিক পর্যবেক্ষণের সাথে, ডেটা একদিনের মধ্যে প্রেরণ করা হয়, এক সপ্তাহের মধ্যে ফুটো হ্রাস করার বৃহত্তর লক্ষ্য সহ, যদিও এটি সুবিধাটির অবস্থান এবং প্রযোজ্য বিধিবিধানের উপর নির্ভর করে। এমন বিধিবিধি রয়েছে যা নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে ফুটা হ্রাস করতে বলে এবং গ্রাহক

title_bn: পার্নিয়ার পপ আপ শপ প্যারেন্ট আইপিওঃ ইস্যুতে ২০% সাবস্ক্রাইব ২য় দিনে এখন পর্যন্ত
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) continued to see steady investor interest on the…
paragraph1: SUMMARYPernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) continued to see steady investor interest on the second day of bidding If the issue is fully subscribed by tomorrow, Purple Style Labs is expected to list on both the NSE and BSE, with the tentative listing date fixed for September 7 As of 13:18 IST, investors have cumulatively placed bids for 13.78 Lakh shares against 68.49 Lakh shares on offer, translating to a 20% subscription Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) continued to see steady investor interest on the second day of bidding. As of 13:18 IST, investors have cumulatively placed bids for 13.78 Lakh shares against 68.49 Lakh shares on offer, translating to a 20% subscription. The highest number of bids have come from retail investors till now, who have placed bids for 10.
paragraph2: 22 Lakh shares against the 12.45 Lakh shares earmarked for them. This translates to a 82% subscription of their quota. Following retail investors, non institutional investors (NIIs) have placed bids for 1.53 Lakh shares against the 18.68 Lakh shares reserved for them. These investors have subscribed their quota by just 8% till now.
paragraph3: Interest from qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) picked up slightly today, with these investors placing bids for 2.15 Lakh shares against the 37.36 lakh shares allocated to them, subscribing their quota by a mere 6% till now. The IPO’s price band was set in the range of ₹546-575 and the lot size is 26 shares. If the issue is fully subscribed by tomorrow, Purple Style Labs is expected to list on both the NSE and BSE, with the tentative listing date fixed for September 7. The IPO is anchored by investors like BofA Securities, Morgan Stanley Asia, Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance, Jupiter India Fund, who cumulatively bought shares worth ₹306 Cr on August 28. Purple Style Labs’ public consists solely of a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹680 Cr, with no offer for sale component.
paragraph4: A big chunk of the fresh IPO proceeds will be used to fund the lease liabilities of Pernia’s Pop Up Stores’ experience centres, while some parts will also fund sales and marketing expenses till FY30. Founded in 2015 by Abhishek Agarwal, Purple Style Labs operates the multi-brand luxury omnichannel fashion platform, Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop. The company claims to sell luxury fashion apparels sourced from 1,109 active designer brands. It sells its products via its own website as well as 12 experience centres. On the financial front, PSL’s consolidated net loss widened 51.5% to ₹285.4 Cr in FY26 compared to ₹188.
paragraph5: 4 Cr incurred in the previous fiscal year. Operating revenue for the fiscal rose nearly 14% to ₹557.8 Cr from ₹489.9 Cr in FY25.

title: Niyo To Acquire Capital India’s RemitX Forex Business For ₹11.4 Cr
title_bn: Niyo To Acquire Capital India’s RemitX Forex Business For ₹11.4 Cr
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Fintech soonicorn Niyo has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the forex and cross-border payments business of listed financial services…
paragraph1: SUMMARYFintech startup Niyo has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the forex and cross-border business of Capital India Finance, operated under the RemitX brand. The acquisition will give digital-first Niyo an established offline distribution network comprising 32 branches and more than 2,500 partners across the country. More than 200 RemitX employees are expected to join Niyo’s subsidiary Kanji Forex after the deal closes, which is expected by October 31. Fintech soonicorn NiYO has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the forex and cross-border payments business of listed financial services company Capital India Finance, operated under the RemitX brand, for ₹11.4 Cr. The transaction will be undertaken through Niyo’s wholly owned subsidiary Kanji Forex Pvt Ltd, which operates under an RBI Authorised Dealer Category-II (AD-II) licence. Capital India Finance’s board yesterday approved the transfer of assets related to RemitX to Kanji Forex. The transaction is expected to be completed by October 31, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and the fulfilment of other conditions.
paragraph2: Following the completion of the deal, Capital India Finance will apply to surrender its AD-II licence, it said in an exchange filing. The financial services company said the divestment is part of its long-term strategy to consolidate its operations and focus on its NBFC platform and digital businesses under RapiPay. The acquisition will add RemitX’s 32 branches across 16 states and more than 30 cities to Niyo’s network, taking the fintech startup’s physical footprint to over 40 locations nationwide. RemitX also has more than 2,500 distribution partners, including travel agents, overseas education consultants, and corporates. Over 200 RemitX employees, including members of its leadership team, are expected to join Kanji Forex after the transaction is completed. The deal will allow Niyo to combine its digital platform for international travel and cross-border payments with RemitX’s branch- and partner-led distribution network. The combined business will offer foreign currency, forex cards, and outward remittance services through physical branches and digital channels. Niyo said the expanded network would also help it reach customers in Tier II and III cities amid growing demand for overseas travel and education.
paragraph3: RemitX contributed ₹24.9 Cr to Capital India Finance’s consolidated turnover in FY26, accounting for 4.68% of the total. The forex business had net assets of ₹28.3 Cr as of March 31, 2026. Founded in 2015 by Vinay Bagri and Virender Bisht, Niyo offers digital banking and travel-related financial services to international travellers, students, and professionals. Its offerings include international debit and credit cards, outward remittances, forex cash, flights, visa assistance, travel insurance, and international eSIMs. Niyo’s zero-forex-markup card allows users to load money in Indian rupees and spend in more than 180 countries without paying an additional forex markup.
paragraph4: The startup has partnered with DCB Bank, SBM Bank, and Visa to offer its card products. Niyo has raised close to $180 Mn to date and counts Accel, Lightrock, Multiples, Tencent, and Prime Venture Partners among its investors. In FY25, the startup narrowed its net loss by about 46% to ₹77.8 Cr from ₹143.5 Cr in the previous fiscal year. Its operating revenue rose 32% YoY to ₹123.4 Cr during the year. The RemitX acquisition is the latest step in Niyo’s push into regulated forex services and cross-border payments.
paragraph5: Niyo entered the regulated forex market in 2025 by acquiring Mumbai-based Kanji Forex, gaining access to an AD-II licence. Earlier this month, the RBI granted Kanji Forex a perpetual AD-II licence with an expanded scope, allowing it to facilitate additional transactions, including trade and family-maintenance remittances. The licence also allows Kanji Forex to expand its branch network without seeking separate approval for every new location. This followed the RBI’s revision of the AD-II framework in May 2026 to expand the scope of such licences to cover nearly all permissible non-trade current-account transactions.

title: Photoroom co-founder quits executive role
title_bn: ফটোগ্রাফির সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা নির্বাহী দায়িত্ব থেকে সরে দাঁড়ালেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: One of the co-founders of French AI photo editing app Photoroom is standing down from his executive role at the Y Combinator alumni startup. Eliot Andres founded Paris-based Photoroom with CEO Matthie...
paragraph1: One of the co-founders of French AI photo editing app Photoroom is standing down from his executive role at the Y Combinator alumni startup. Eliot Andres founded Paris-based Photoroom with CEO Matthieu Rouif in 2019, with the aim of democratising photo editing with an easy-to-use photo editing app. Photoroom leverages AI to help brands and individual sellers edit shots into professional-looking visuals in seconds.
paragraph2: Andres has spent the bulk of his time as CTO at Photoroom but transitioned to a contributor role this year. Confirming his departure on LinkedIn, Andres said: "After seven years, I’m stepping down from my executive role at Photoroom. I’ll remain involved in strategic decisions as a board member.
paragraph3: There is no perfect time for a founder to step back, but I'm confident the time is right. "In our Y Combinator application, we wrote: ‘Our long-term goal is to allow anyone to make professional edits without any training.’ This dream is finally becoming a reality, thanks to our work and advances in AI.
paragraph4: ” On what’s next, Andres said: “I’m taking a bit of time to reflect on my next projects. They won’t stray far from AI or apps.” Rouif said: “Excited to keep partnering with you as a founder and board member.
paragraph5: ” Andres is being replaced as CTO by Javier Sotelo, a former Groupon executive who joined Photoroom at the start of the year. Photoroom, valued at €500m, raised €43m in 2024 in a Series B funding round. Its enterprise clients include DoorDash, Wolt and Decathlon.

title: Apple iPhone 18: Leaked design, bigger battery, camera upgrades, price and launch date
title_bn: Apple iPhone 18: Leaked design, bigger battery, camera upgrades, price and launch date
author: TechPulse
excerpt: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected to launch on 9 September 2026, with a smaller Dynamic Island, under-display Face ID, variable-aperture camera, A20 Pro chip, larger battery and a $250-300 price hike, followed by a foldable iPhone in October.
paragraph1: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected to launch on 9 September 2026, with a smaller Dynamic Island, under-display Face ID, variable-aperture camera, A20 Pro chip, larger battery and a $250-300 price hike, followed by a foldable iPhone in October.Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max leaks from X. (Unconfirmed by Apple)(X)Apple is expected to make major changes to its iPhone lineup with the iPhone 18 series. The upcoming models could feature a smaller Dynamic Island, upgraded cameras, more RAM and larger batteries. Apple is also reportedly preparing its first foldable iPhone.Apple may launch the iPhone 18 lineup in two phases. The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are expected to arrive in September 2026, while the much-rumoured foldable iPhone could debut in October. The standard iPhone 18, iPhone 18e and potentially a second-generation iPhone Air could follow in early 2027.iPhone 18 design and Dynamic IslandThe iPhone 18 Pro models are expected to retain the 6.
paragraph2: 3-inch and 6.9-inch display sizes of the previous generation.One of the biggest design changes could involve the Dynamic Island. Apple is reportedly exploring a smaller version, with some Face ID components potentially moving underneath the display.According to The Information, the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max could feature under-display Face ID, while the front camera may move towards the top-left corner. Other reports suggest Apple will not remove the Dynamic Island entirely but could narrow it.The Pro models could also receive new colour options, including light blue, dark cherry and dark grey. Leaked dummy units have reportedly suggested that the previously rumoured coffee-brown finish may not make it to the final lineup.iPhone 18 battery and camera upgradesThe iPhone 18 Pro could receive a significantly larger battery.
paragraph3: Apple has not confirmed the battery capacity, but a Weibo leak suggests that some versions could feature batteries with capacities of up to 5,000mAh.Camera upgrades could also be a major focus. According to Macworld, the iPhone 18 Pro Max could feature a variable-aperture camera.A variable aperture would allow greater control over the amount of light reaching the sensor and could provide more control over depth of field. The Information has also reported that at least one of the iPhone 18 Pro's rear cameras could use a mechanical iris.Meanwhile, MacRumors reports that a 24MP front camera could be introduced across the iPhone 18 lineup, excluding the iPhone 18e.An A20 chip and more RAMThe iPhone 18 series is expected to debut Apple's next-generation A20 and A20 Pro chips. The processors could be manufactured using TSMC's 2nm process, potentially improving performance and power efficiency.The new iPhones could also receive more RAM.
paragraph4: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo has suggested that lower-end iPhone 18 models could have 9GB of RAM, while analyst Jeff Pu has reportedly tipped 12GB of RAM for the standard iPhone 18.However, memory costs and supply constraints could influence Apple's final component choices and specifications.iPhone 18 pricesHigher component costs may also affect pricing. Partly due to the new 2 nm chip and memory costs, MacRumors reported that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max could end up costing between $250 and $300 more than the older model. Apple hasn't announced any price changes.iPhone 18 release dateThe provided report states that Apple's Fall event will take place on 9 September 2026. There's no official confirmation on the date for preorder sales, but it could start on 11 September.According to Bloomberg, Apple might unveil the Pro models and foldable iPhone in the fall of 2026 and the standard iPhone 18 in February or March 2027, with the iPhone Air 2 possible later in the year.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing.
paragraph5: She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

title: Alteon Raises $2.5 Mn To Develop Long-Endurance Autonomous Aircraft
title_bn: Alteon Raises $2.5 Mn To Develop Long-Endurance Autonomous Aircraft
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Bengaluru-based startup Alteon has raised $2.5 Mn (about ₹24 Cr) in a pre-seed round led by Lachy Groom, with participation…
paragraph1: SUMMARYAlteon has raised $2.5 Mn in pre-seed funding to advance its wind-powered autonomous aircraft and work towards deploying fleets capable of staying airborne for months Alteon’s ultra-long-endurance aircraft could enable persistent ocean monitoring, defence and surveillance without the refuelling and infrastructure needed by conventional aircraft The Bengaluru-based startup recently demonstrated autonomous flight less than a metre above the ocean and is targeting aircraft that can eventually stay airborne for more than a year using dynamic soaring Bengaluru-based startup Alteon has raised $2.5 Mn (about ₹24 Cr) in a pre-seed round led by Lachy Groom, with participation from Together Fund, as it works on autonomous aircraft designed to stay airborne for months without landing. The fresh capital will be used to advance its autonomous dynamic-soaring technology, scale R&D and deploy fleets of aircraft over the ocean, the startup said in a statement. The funding comes shortly after Alteon’s aircraft completed an offshore flight test, autonomously flying multiple consecutive loops less than a metre above the ocean’s surface.
paragraph2: The test marked a key milestone in the startup’s efforts to develop ultra-long-endurance aircraft using dynamic soaring. The startup’s founder Samay Sanghvi began work on the tech driving the radio-controlled aircraft back in 2023 before incorporating the startup in 2025. He developed the prototypes without a formal engineering degree and received early backing from Emergent Ventures and 1517. The startup has since expanded its team to 20. Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft that use wind energy to stay airborne for months, similar to how albatrosses fly.
paragraph3: Unlike conventional aircraft that need to land for refueling and maintenance, the startup aims to build aircraft capable of persistent flight without relying on traditional propulsion. One of its key engineering challenges is enabling the aircraft to perform dynamic-soaring manoeuvres autonomously close to the surface of a moving ocean. “Ultra high endurance is downstream of ultra high efficiency, precision and reliability,” said Sanghvi. “Day in, day out we put our aircraft in the air and learn from every build, every flight and every failure to get closer to building aircraft that can stay airborne for more than a year.” The startup is ultimately aiming to build aircraft capable of staying airborne for more than a year, potentially enabling continuous observation of the oceans and helping authorities monitor activities such as illegal fishing and drug trafficking.
paragraph4: The fundraise comes as India’s UAV market continues to expand, driven by rising demand for unmanned systems across defence, surveillance, infrastructure and logistics. The market is also seeing a growing set of startups building autonomous and long-endurance aircraft. NewSpace Research & Technologies, CDSpace Robotics and Aspera Aerospace are also developing unmanned systems for defence and surveillance, while Airbound is building autonomous aircraft for logistics and recently raised $37 Mn in a Series A round. Meanwhile, eVTOLs are also expected to fill the Indian skies soon. Startups like LAT Aerospace, the E-Plane Company, Sarla Aviation, and BLUJ Aero, are furthering their bids to build electric flying taxis.
paragraph5: The development comes as India’s UAV market gains traction across commercial and defence applications, with the market valued at $470 Mn in 2025 and projected to reach $1.39 Bn by 2030 at a 24.

title: From $3.5 Bn To $200 Mn: upGrad Completes Unacademy Acquisition
title_bn: From $3.5 Bn To $200 Mn: upGrad Completes Unacademy Acquisition
author: TechPulse
excerpt: After months of negotiations and regulatory clearances, edtech major upGrad has completed its acquisition of Unacademy in a deal valued…
paragraph1: SUMMARYupGrad has completed its acquisition of Unacademy in a deal valued at just over $200 Mn, the latter’s cofounder Gaurav Munjal said The final transaction value represents a decline of more than 94% from Unacademy’s peak valuation of $3.5 Bn in 2021 Munjal said Unacademy had a topline of around ₹400 Cr, ₹900 Cr in the bank, and most of its businesses were profitable or nearing profitability at the time of the transaction After months of negotiations and regulatory clearances, edtech major upGrad has completed its acquisition of Unacademy in a deal valued at just over $200 Mn. Unacademy cofounder Gaurav Munjal announced the closure of the transaction in a post on X today. “We raised at a peak, but sold at a fraction of that.
paragraph2: I’m not going to dress these facts up. But I am proud of what this team did between those two numbers,” Munjal said. The final transaction value represents a decline of more than 94% from Unacademy’s peak valuation of $3.5 Bn in 2021.
paragraph3: The startup has raised more than $830 Mn to date from investors such as SoftBank, Peak XV Partners, Elevation Capital, Blume Ventures, and Meta. The acquisition will give Ronnie Screwvala-led upGrad a foothold in the K-12 and competitive exam preparation segments. upGrad primarily operates in the higher education and professional upskilling space. The CCI approved the deal in July.
paragraph4: Munjal said Unacademy was not forced into the transaction because of a cash crunch. At the time of the acquisition, Unacademy had a topline of around ₹400 Cr and about ₹900 Cr in the bank, while most of its businesses were profitable or close to profitability, he claimed. “With a topline of around 400 Cr, most businesses profitable or near-profitable, and 900 Cr in the bank, we had every option to keep going independently. Nobody was forcing this,” Munjal said.

title: Space Cargo Unlimited invests in CNES subsidiary Novespace to expand microgravity offering
title_bn: স্পেস কার্গো আনলিমিটেড মাইক্রোগ্রাভিটি অফার সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সিএনইএস এর সহায়ক সংস্থা নভেস্পেসে বিনিয়োগ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Space Cargo Unlimited (Space Cargo), which develops autonomous space manufacturing platforms and mission services for commercial microgravity research and manufacturing, has announced a strategic inve...
paragraph1: Space Cargo Unlimited (Space Cargo), which develops autonomous space manufacturing platforms and mission services for commercial microgravity research and manufacturing, has announced a strategic investment in Novespace, Europe's leading provider of parabolic flight services and a subsidiary of CNES (France’s national space agency ). Parabolic flight services are flights in specially modified aircraft that repeatedly climb and dive along a parabolic trajectory. During part of each manoeuvre, the aircraft and everything inside it are effectively in free fall, creating around 22 seconds of microgravity. Researchers use this to test hardware, conduct biological and medical experiments, and validate technologies before sending them into space.
paragraph2: The move comes at a pivotal moment for Europe's space sector as governments and industry prepare for a future beyond the International Space Station, where commercial providers will play an increasingly important role in supporting research, manufacturing and human spaceflight. As commercial activity in low Earth orbit continues to evolve, complementary platforms will become increasingly important in providing more flexible and repeatable access to microgravity for research, manufacturing and future commercial missions. The investment makes Space Cargo a shareholder alongside CNES, expanding the company's portfolio of microgravity access points and reinforcing its long-term vision to build an integrated fleet supporting research, technology development, manufacturing and return-to-Earth operations. At the centre of this strategy is BentoBox, Space Cargo’s modular Space Factory platform, which enables customers to access microgravity across multiple vehicles and mission profiles.
paragraph3: The addition of Novespace brings parabolic flight into a wider offering alongside future orbital manufacturing and return-to-Earth capabilities, giving customers greater flexibility to select the right platform for each stage of product development. For more than 35 years, Novespace, a subsidiary of CNES, has enabled researchers, technology developers and astronauts to access short-duration microgravity through parabolic flight campaigns. These flights provide an important environment for testing and validating technologies before they progress to longer-duration orbital missions, making Novespace a natural addition to Space Cargo Unlimited's growing fleet of complementary microgravity platforms. Nicolas Gaume, Co-founder and CEO of Space Cargo, said: "Europe has world-class science, engineering and innovation.
paragraph4: The next challenge is giving researchers and businesses access to the right infrastructure to turn ideas into products. By investing in Novespace, we're strengthening that journey from early microgravity research through to future commercial manufacturing in orbit." Thomas Pesquet, CEO of Novespace, added: "Parabolic flight sits at the crossroads of extreme aviation and cutting-edge space research. What Novespace has achieved so far is nothing short of remarkable, establishing itself as the world leader in its field.
paragraph5: I’m incredibly proud to be part of this team, and there is nowhere else I would rather be today… except perhaps in space! We are delighted to welcome SCU as a shareholder, helping us open the door to new markets and new customers. With the extraordinary momentum we are seeing today in space exploration and research, the possibilities ahead are limitless.” As part of the investment, Nicolas Gaume will join the Novespace Board, strengthening collaboration between the two organisations as they continue to develop a more integrated commercial microgravity offering.
bangla_paragraph1: স্পেস কার্গো আনলিমিটেড (স্পেস কার্গো), যা বাণিজ্যিক মাইক্রোগ্রাভিটি গবেষণা এবং উত্পাদনের জন্য স্বয়ংক্রিয় মহাকাশ উত্পন্ন প্ল্যাটফর্ম এবং মিশন পরিষেবা বিকাশ করে, ইউরোপের শীর্ষস্থানীয় প্যারাবলিক ফ্লাইট পরিষেবা সরবরাহকারী এবং সিএনইএস (ফ্রান্সের জাতীয় মহাকাস সংস্থা) এর একটি সহায়ক সংস্থা নোভস্পেসে কৌশলগত বিনিয়োগের ঘোষণা দিয়েছে। প্যারিবলিক ফ্লাইট পরিষেবাগুলি বিশেষভাবে পরিবর্তিত বিমানে ফ্লাইট যা বারবার প্যারবলিক ট্র্যাজেক্টরি বরাবর আরোহণ এবং ডুব দেয়। প্রতিটি চালনার অংশের সময়, প্যারাবিলিক ফ্লাইন পরিষেবাগুলি হ'ল প্যারোবলিক ফ্লায়ার।
bangla_paragraph2: ইউরোপের মহাকাশ খাতের জন্য এই পদক্ষেপ একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মুহুর্তে আসে কারণ সরকার এবং শিল্প আন্তর্জাতিক মহাকাশে স্টেশন ছাড়িয়ে ভবিষ্যতের জন্য প্রস্তুত হয়, যেখানে বাণিজ্যিক সরবরাহকারীরা গবেষণা, উত্পাদন এবং মানব মহাকাশা ফ্লাইটকে সমর্থন করার ক্ষেত্রে ক্রমবর্ধমান গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করবে।
bangla_paragraph3: নোভস্পেসের যোগদান ভবিষ্যতের কক্ষপথ উত্পাদন এবং পৃথিবীতে ফিরে যাওয়ার সক্ষমতার পাশাপাশি প্যারাবলিক ফ্লাইটকে আরও বিস্তৃত অফারে নিয়ে আসে, গ্রাহকদের পণ্য বিকাশের প্রতিটি পর্যায়ে সঠিক প্ল্যাটফর্ম নির্বাচন করার জন্য আরও নমনীয়তা দেয়। ৩৫ বছরেরও বেশি সময় ধরে, সিএনইএসের একটি সহায়ক সংস্থা নোভস্পেস গবেষকরা, প্রযুক্তি বিকাশকারী এবং মহাকাশচারীদের প্যারিবলিক ফ্লাইটিং প্রচারের মাধ্যমে স্বল্প-দৈর্ঘ্য মাইক্রোগ্রাভিটি অ্যাক্সেস করতে সক্ষম করেছে। এই ফ্লাইটগুলি পরীক্ষার জন্য একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পরিবেশ সরবরাহ করে।
bangla_paragraph4: পরবর্তী চ্যালেঞ্জ হচ্ছে গবেষক এবং ব্যবসায়ীদের সঠিক অবকাঠামোতে অ্যাক্সেস দেওয়া যাতে তারা তাদের ধারণাকে পণ্যে রূপান্তর করতে পারে। নোভস্পেসে বিনিয়োগ করে, আমরা ক্ষুদ্র মহাকর্ষের প্রাথমিক গবেষণা থেকে ভবিষ্যতে কক্ষপথে বাণিজ্যিক উত্পাদন পর্যন্ত সেই যাত্রাটিকে শক্তিশালী করছি। " নোভসপেসের প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা থমাস পেসকেট যোগ করেছেনঃ "প্যারাবলিক ফ্লাইট চরম বিমান চলাচল এবং অত্যাধুনিক মহাকাশ গবেষণার ক্রসওয়েতে অবস্থিত। নভস্পেসের এখন পর্যন্ত যা অর্জন করেছে তা উল্লেখযোগ্য, এটি নিজেকে বিশ্বের অন্যতম প্রতিষ্ঠিত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: আমি এই দলের অংশ হতে পেরে অবিশ্বাস্যভাবে গর্বিত, এবং আজকে আমি অন্য কোথাও থাকতে চাই না ... সম্ভবত মহাকাশ ছাড়া! আমরা স্কিউকে শেয়ারহোল্ডার হিসাবে স্বাগত জানাতে পেরে আনন্দিত, নতুন বাজার এবং নতুন গ্রাহকদের দরজা খোলার ক্ষেত্রে আমাদের সহায়তা করে। মহাকাশে অন্বেষণ এবং গবেষণায় আমরা আজ যে অসাধারণ গতি দেখি, সামনে সম্ভাবনার সীমাহীনতা রয়েছে। বিনিয়োগের অংশ হিসাবে, নিকোলাস গোম নোভস্পেসের বোর্ডে যোগ দেবেন, উভয় সংস্থার মধ্যে সহযোগিতা জোরদার করবেন কারণ তারা অব্যাহত রয়েছে।

title: OnePlus 16 leak reveals ‘final’ camera specs, and it’s what the OnePlus 15 should’ve had
title_bn: OnePlus 16 leak reveals ‘final’ camera specs, and it’s what the OnePlus 15 should’ve had
author: TechPulse
excerpt: A worthy successor to the OnePlus 13's camera system?
paragraph1: Ryan Haines / Android AuthorityTL;DR The OnePlus 16’s “final” camera specs have apparently leaked online. The phone is said to have a 200MP main camera, a new 50MP ultrawide camera, and a 50MP 3x camera. It looks like the 3x camera is virtually identical to the one seen on the OnePlus 13. The OnePlus 15 was a bit of a disappointment on the camera front compared to the OnePlus 13. However, various leaks in 2026 suggest that the OnePlus 16 could have upgraded camera hardware.
paragraph2: Now, a trusted tipster has revealed “final” camera specs.Leaker Digital Chat Station on Weibo has revealed what might be the definitive OnePlus 16 camera specs. Check out the machine-translated screenshot below.The leaker claims that the phone will have a 200MP 1/1.4-inch main camera, a 50MP 3x 1/1.
paragraph3: 95-inch telephoto shooter, and a 50MP ultrawide camera. This is rounded out by a 50MP selfie shooter with autofocus. Digital Chat Station also claims that the phone will inherit OPPO’s latest generation of flagship imaging tech.In other words, those early leaks about a 200MP telephoto camera weren’t accurate. The 50MP telephoto camera seems identical to the OnePlus 13’s 3x camera, though, and we praised the older phone for its camera zoom capabilities.
paragraph4: So it stands to reason that camera zoom quality should be on par with the OnePlus 13, if not a little better due to upgraded image processing. Nevertheless, we’re guessing this 200MP main camera will deliver improved image quality over the OnePlus 15’s relatively small 50MP primary shooter.Otherwise, the OnePlus 16 was previously tipped to arrive with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset, a 9,000mAh battery, and a 165Hz screen. So even if you can’t officially get your hands on this device in Europe or the US, you might want to add it to your wishlist.FollowThank you for being part of our community.
paragraph5: Read our Comment Policy before posting.

title: Kepler Aerospace Raises $8 Mn To Launch Six Autonomous Surveillance Satellites
title_bn: Kepler Aerospace Raises $8 Mn To Launch Six Autonomous Surveillance Satellites
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Spacetech startup Kepler Aerospace has raised $8 Mn (around ₹75.8 Cr) in a seed funding round led by Blue Ashva…
paragraph1: SUMMARYKepler Aerospace has raised $8 Mn in its maiden external funding round to deploy six autonomous swarming ISR satellites under two iDEX contracts The startup aims to reduce the time taken to deliver space-based intelligence from months to minutes by combining satellites, ground stations, and mission operations Kepler will also scale its mission operations and avionics businesses, move to a new facility, and add 40 employees over the next 12 to 24 months Spacetech startup Kepler Aerospace has raised $8 Mn (around ₹75.8 Cr) in a seed funding round led by Blue Ashva Capital and co-led by Finvolve, India Accelerator, and other investors. The round marks the Bengaluru-based startup’s first external fundraise since its inception in 2018. Kepler will use the fresh capital to develop and deploy its space-based intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities, while expanding its mission operations and avionics-as-a-service businesses. A key part of the funding will be used to launch its first six autonomous swarming ISR satellites under two iDEX contracts secured for India’s defence space ecosystem. The programmes have also received around $4 Mn in grants under iDEX.
paragraph2: ISR satellites monitor designated areas from space and collect information that can be used for defence and national security operations. Kepler claims its proposed satellites will be capable of communicating with, assigning tasks to, and acting in coordination with one another in orbit without waiting for instructions from a ground station. The startup said it aims to reduce the time taken to convert space-based data into actionable intelligence from months to minutes through these persistent ISR systems and its integrated mission infrastructure. Kepler’s Space Infrastructure Play Founded by Navneet Singh and Kiran V Sharma, Kepler builds and operates infrastructure required across the lifecycle of a satellite mission. The startup makes satellite avionics and subsystems, including onboard computers, power systems, radio frequency payloads, and communication and navigation modules. These are electronic systems installed inside satellites to control their operations, power supply, navigation, and communication.
paragraph3: It also provides ground station and mission operations services. These allow satellite operators to communicate with, track, control, and receive data from their satellites after they are placed in orbit. Kepler’s third focus area is space-based intelligence, under which it plans to operate satellites that collect and process surveillance data for defence and national security applications. In simple terms, the startup makes some of the electronic systems used inside satellites, provides the ground infrastructure required to operate them, and is now building its own satellites to collect defence intelligence. Kepler said its mission operations platform serves nearly all Indian space companies and acts as the primary mission operator for several ISRO satellites. The startup also claimed that it provides satellite communication, tracking, telemetry, command, and mission operations services through a network of more than 70 ground stations.
paragraph4: Over the next 12 to 24 months, Kepler will focus on deploying the satellites, expanding its mission operations and avionics-as-a-service businesses, and strengthening its engineering capabilities. The startup is also moving to a new facility and plans to add 40 employees to its existing team. India’s Spacetech Push The fundraise comes as India’s private spacetech ecosystem expands beyond launch vehicles and satellites into areas such as space-based intelligence, defence applications, satellite subsystems, ground infrastructure, and mission operations. The shift is already visible in the growing capabilities of Indian spacetech startups. In July, spacetech unicorn Skyroot Aerospace became the first private Indian company to place a rocket into orbit, with its Vikram-1 launch vehicle completing Mission Aagaman after lifting off from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. Meanwhile, Agnikul Cosmos onboarded former ISRO chairman S Somanath as an observer on its board as the startup prepares for its second space mission.
paragraph5: The mission will involve recovering an orbital-class rocket booster and extending the rocket’s upper stage into an on-orbit platform. At the heart of this push is India’s commercial spacetech market, which is projected to reach $77 Bn by 2030, growing at a CAGR of 26%.
